summary: This is an 8-K filing by Strategy Inc (formerly MicroStrategy) announcing a dividend rate maintenance and declaration on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC). The board declared a cash dividend of $0.95833333 per share for the month ending May 31, 2026, representing an 11.50% per annum rate, payable on May 31, 2026 to holders of record as of May 15, 2026. The company expects the dividend to be treated as a non-taxable return of capital. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation.
